display.title: Ascension III - Reach Tier 4
display.subtitle: 2000 tokens, or the full T3 boss-rush
description: The final ascension before the endgame. Tier 4 opens the Aether (Deep
Aether's biomes included) and the road to the End.
Completes when the Codex engine grants you the Tier 4 stage - whether
you banked 2000 tokens or completed the entire Tier 3 boss-rush
§7Tier 4 also opens the Ad Astra planets and their orbits (a rocket
§7and the Rocket Workbench, no dragon kill). Eyes of Ender lead to
§7the End and the Ender Dragon - the pack finale.

engine_grants_t4.title: Be granted the Tier 4 stage by the Codex
